search.label: Search your files
search.placeholder: Search your files - or paste a passage to find more like it

results.label: Results
results.wordsHint: The words of the query occur in this document
results.someWordsHint: Some of the words of the query occur in this document - no document has them all
results.acrossHint: Found by meaning in another language than the query. The sentence closest to it is marked.
results.ocrHint: Read by OCR from a picture: a word here may be misread.
results.nothingBody: Nothing contains these words, and nothing is close in meaning. Try other words, or fewer.
results.typeBody: Words in any form: a search for “contracts” finds “contract”.
results.partial: no document has every word - these have some
results.nothingSimilar: Nothing in your files is close to this passage.
results.behind_one: {{count}} document not read for meaning yet
results.behind_other: {{count}} documents not read for meaning yet
results.meaningHint: Close in meaning to the query, whatever the words: {{score}}

sources.noneBody: Add a folder - notes, text files, an Obsidian vault. Nothing in it leaves this machine.

status.meaningBusy: another nooma is reading for meaning
status.heldHint: The machine runs on its battery: reading files waits for the power, and goes on by itself once it is back.
status.watchingHint: Watching the folders: a file saved is found a moment later.
status.unwatchedHint: The folders are not watched: changes are read when the window opens or comes back into focus.

meaning.needsModel: Search by meaning needs its model
meaning.needsModelBody: {{size}} MB, downloaded once from Hugging Face. It is the one download nooma ever makes - your files never leave this machine.
meaning.readingOf: Reading your documents for meaning: {{done}} of {{total}} passages
meaning.notYet: Nothing has been read for meaning yet.

health.title: What the index lacks
health.body: Files in your folders that are not searched, or searched only in part. A file is tried again when it changes.

whyHint.locked: nooma does not open what is locked. A copy saved without the password is found.
whyHint.damaged: Their reader could not make sense of them: cut off, damaged, or written in a way it does not follow. Hover a file for what it said.
whyHint.too_large: Larger than nooma reads a document of their kind.
whyHint.unopened: Held by another program, or not allowed to be read. Tried again at every update.
whyHint.not_a_document: Their names say documents, their contents say otherwise: an archive, a recording, an old Office file.

health.textlessHint: PDFs and books with no text in them - scans, most likely. They are found by their names.
health.textlessNoOcr: Scans, found by their names: text in pictures is not read on this machine.
health.unrecognized: Read without their pictures of text
health.unrecognizedHint: Pages that are pictures of text could not be read; the rest of each document is searched.
health.guessedHint: Not UTF-8, so the encoding was guessed. A wrong guess reads as gibberish, and such a file is found by nothing.
health.unavailableHint: A drive unplugged, or a folder moved: what was found in it is kept as it was.
